name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.7.4 adds a standalone vector tech-priest reconstruction asset. v0.7.0: Windows 11 verification pass — DPI-aware hairlines for 125%/150% scaling, density-corrected filigree strokes, host-aligned scrollbar width, Windows caption-row awareness, Contrast Themes support, reduced-motion splash skip, throttled re-tagging, Palatino Linotype in SVG ornament lettering. v0.6.3 fixes native Platform WebContentsView layout; v0.6.2 adds account/Platform click + splash guards; v0.6.1 fixes blank file-card icons and expanded reasoning-row icons; v0.6.0 redesigns changed-file/deliverable cards + expanded ToolRow icons; v0.5.3 startup title 铸造圣殿; v0.5.2 deep-diving/process icons; v0.5.1 composer removeChild fix; v0.5.0 startup splash; v0.4.2 icon restoration. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。 v0.7.2 restyles the tech-priest asset as gold/red contours without the miniature base. v0.7.3 redraws the tech-priest as pure gold/red line art without the base. v0.7.4 strips the tech-priest asset down to gold/red strokes only, no fills or base.
